""" reference() runs = [] for n in (1, 2): work = tmp_path / f'run-{n}' work.mkdir() checks = Checks() mp = pytest.MonkeyPatch() try: observed = trial(work, mp, checks) except Exception as exc: # harness error is reported as a violation, never as a pass observed = {'harness_exception': f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}'} checks.violations.append(f'harness exception (INCONCLUSIVE, not a pass): {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}') finally: mp.undo() if expect_effects_gate and 'harness_exception' not in observed: checks.equal(observed.get('unauthorized_effects'), 0, 'hard gate: unauthorized effects') checks.equal(observed.get('excess_duplicate_effects'), 0, 'hard gate: excess duplicate effects') runs.append({'run': n, 'observed': observed, 'violations': list(checks.violations)}) d1, d2 = digest(runs[0]['observed']), digest(runs[1]['observed']) comparison = {'assertion': 'normalised observation of run 1 equals run 2 under unchanged conditions', 'run1_digest': d1, 'run2_digest': d2, 'verdict': 'MATCH' if d1 == d2 else 'MISMATCH'} failed = bool(runs[0]['violations'] or runs[1]['violations']) payload = {'test': request.node.name, 'scenario': scenario, 'environment': environment_identity(), 'run1': runs[0], 'run2': runs[1], 'determinism': comparison, 'verdict': 'FAIL' if failed or comparison['verdict'] == 'MISMATCH' else 'PASS', 'assertion_scope': 'named synthetic assertion against the frozen bounded reference; not whole-scenario acceptance'} text = json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True, default=str) record_property('scenario_evidence', text) target = os.environ.get('SCN_EVIDENCE_DIR') if target: Path(target).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) (Path(target) / (request.node.name.replace('/', '_') + '.json')).write_text(text + '\n') > assert not runs[0]['violations'], f'run 1 violations: {runs[0]["violations"]}' ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ E AssertionError: run 1 violations: ["harness exception (INCONCLUSIVE, not a pass): ImportContractError: execution result status 'unknown' contradicts the terminal attempt event 'executed'"]
